format:
<template>
    <Teleport v-if="mounted" to="#app-bar-title">
        <v-btn-group variant="outlined" divided>
            <v-btn @click="oe_nav('test')" :title="oe_titles.test" icon="mdi-dev-to"></v-btn> 
        </v-btn-group>
    </Teleport>
</template>

<script>
    export default {
        data() {
            return {
                oe_menus: {  },
                oe_titles: {  },
                mounted: false
            }
        },
        mounted() {
            this.mounted = true;
        },
        methods: {
            oe_nav: function (page) {
                this.send(page)
            }
        },
        watch: {
            msg: function (msg) {
                this.oe_menus = msg.menus;
                this.oe_titles = msg.titles;
            }
        }
    }

</script>
